fields.description: Issue includes editorials and satirical commentary on post-election South Florida conditions, especially rising rents and the seasonal influx of visitors; discussion of local politics and civic affairs; coverage touching on Prohibition enforcement and liquor-related news (including Key West), transportation and rail service, and public-safety concerns such as hazardous gasoline boats in the harbor. Also contains nightlife and entertainment listings/advertising for clubs and shows, and local sports and community notes.
